enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, though sleep is restless and frequently broken
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Turn onto right side. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Shift legs. Open eyes. Look at ceiling. Turn onto left side. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn onto back. Move arm. Turn onto right side again. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Shift position. Pull blanket. Turn onto left side. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking with mild chronic pain, lying still and doing slow gentle stretches and breathing to settle back down
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Lie still on back. Inhale slowly. Exhale slowly. Lift right arm. Rotate wrist clockwise. Rotate wrist counterclockwise. Lower right arm. Lift left arm. Rotate wrist clockwise. Rotate wrist counterclockwise. Lower left arm. Bend right knee. Straighten right leg. Bend left knee. Straighten left leg. Inhale deeply. Exhale slowly. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping again after the pain settles
enriched_activities.desc: Close eyes. Turn onto right side. Pull blanket. Breathe slowly. Shift legs. Turn onto left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Open eyes briefly. Turn onto back. Close eyes. Turn onto right side. Pull blanket. Shift position. Open eyes. Look at clock. Close eyes. Turn onto left side. Breathe deeply. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Slow waking, lying in bed and scrolling Instagram and Messenger on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Stretch arms. Reach for phone on bedside table. Pick up phone. Press power button. Swipe screen. Enter passcode. Open Instagram. Scroll feed. Tap like on post. Open Messenger. Read message from friend. Tap reply. Type message. Send. Put phone down on chest. Close eyes briefly. Open eyes. Pick up phone again. Scroll Instagram. Put phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking daily medication with water and doing gentle mobility stretches for chronic pain and stiff joints
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up. Pick up medication bottle. Open cap. Take pill. Drink water. Stand up. Stretch arms overhead. Bend forward. Straighten up. Sit on bed. Rotate ankles.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, washing and getting dressed at an unhurried pace
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick clothes. Put on underwear, shirt, pants. Comb hair.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a caffeine-free breakfast while listening to a public health podcast (joined by Member 2 for tea and toast from 08:10-08:25)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and bread. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on cooker. Crack eggs. Cook eggs. Toast bread. Pour herbal tea. Sit at table. Open podcast on phone. Play podcast. Eat breakfast. At 08:10, Member 2 enters. Greet Member 2. Pour tea for Member 2. Share toast. Talk with Member 2. At 08:25, Member 2 leaves. Finish eating. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying up the kitchen bench
enriched_activities.desc: Collect plates and cups. Carry to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse dishes. Apply dish soap to sponge. Scrub plates. Scrub cups. Rinse dishes. Place in drying rack. Wipe counter with cloth. Turn off tap.

enriched_activities.activity: PhD research work: literature review and thesis drafting on Computer at desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 3. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Log in. Open browser. Go to academic database. Search for articles. Read abstract. Download PDF. Open PDF. Read article. Take notes in notebook. Open Word document. Type thesis section. Save document. Open second article. Read. Summarize. Type more. Check references. Save again.

enriched_activities.activity: Making herbal tea and a small snack, no caffeine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle. Boil water. Place tea bag in mug. Pour water. Wait. Remove tea bag. Take biscuits from pantry. Sit. Drink tea. Eat biscuits.

enriched_activities.activity: PhD data analysis and reference management on Computer
enriched_activities.desc: Return to desk. Open statistical software. Import dataset. Run descriptive statistics. Check output. Run regression. Check results. Open reference manager. Add new reference. Edit citation. Format bibliography. Open thesis document. Insert citation. Save document. Run another analysis. Check for errors. Save again. Close software.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch at home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, tofu, rice. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add tofu. Add soy sauce. Stir. Turn off cooker. Place rice in bowl. Add cooked vegetables. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking through the neighbourhood as a midday break and mobility routine
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Open front door. Step outside. Close door. Walk along sidewalk. Turn left at corner. Walk past park. Continue walking. Turn right at next street. Walk uphill. Reach top. Turn around. Walk back downhill. Turn left. Walk past shops. Turn right. Walk home. Open front door. Enter. Close door. Remove shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing the support shift roster and client care notes on phone, packing a small bag
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Open roster app. Read shift times. Open notes app. Read client care notes. Put phone down. Open backpack. Place water bottle inside. Place snacks inside. Place gloves inside. Place hand sanitizer inside. Zip backpack. Pick up phone again. Check messages. Put phone down. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the client's home for the disability and aged-care support shift
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up backpack. Walk to front door. Open door. Step outside. Close door. Lock door. Walk along sidewalk. Turn left at corner. Cross street. Walk past supermarket. Turn right. Walk two blocks. Arrive at client's house. Walk up driveway. Knock on door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a disability and aged-care support shift: personal care assistance, meal preparation, medication prompting and companionship
enriched_activities.desc: Enter client's home. Greet client. Assist with shower. Help dress. Prepare lunch. Cook meal. Serve meal. Sit with client. Prompt medication. Give medication. Wash dishes. Sit in living room. Talk. Play cards. Prepare afternoon tea. Serve tea. Assist with walking. Prepare dinner. Cook dinner. Serve dinner. Prompt evening medication. Assist to bed. Say goodbye.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking home from the support shift
enriched_activities.desc: Say goodbye to client. Walk out front door. Close door. Walk down driveway. Turn left. Walk along sidewalk. Cross street. Walk past supermarket. Turn right at corner. Walk two blocks. Turn left. Walk along park. Turn right. Walk home. Open front door. Enter. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting and doing gentle stretches to manage chronic pain after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 3. Sit on bed. Lie down on back. Inhale deeply. Exhale slowly. Lift right leg. Stretch hamstring. Lower leg. Lift left leg. Stretch hamstring. Lower leg. Bend knees. Rotate hips. Straighten legs. Sit up. Rotate neck left. Rotate neck right. Roll shoulders. Stand up. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a late dinner at home
enriched_activities.desc: Open refrigerator. Take out leftovers. Place on plate. Put plate in microwave. Close door. Press start. Wait. Remove plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear plate. Wash plate. Put away leftovers. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pat dry. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out pajamas. Put on pajamas. Fold day clothes. Place on chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner and wiping down the kitchen surfaces
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Collect dishes. Carry to sink. Wash dishes. Rinse. Place in drying rack. Spray counter with cleaner. Wipe counter with cloth. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Household administration: paying bills by mobile wallet, updating the shared roster and logging maintenance tasks on Computer and phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 3. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Log in. Open banking website. Pay electricity bill. Pay internet bill. Open shared roster document. Update roster. Open maintenance log. Add task. Save. Pick up phone. Open mobile wallet. Confirm payment. Put phone down. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down: planning tomorrow, checking distant elder-care arrangements and reading quietly
enriched_activities.desc: Open planner. Write tomorrow's tasks. Check calendar. Pick up phone. Open messaging app. Send message to elder-care facility. Read reply. Put phone down. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Place book on bedside table.

enriched_activities.activity: Lights out and going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Turn off desk lamp. Lie down in bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto side. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Sleep.
